summary: Three kinds of setting (safe defaults, per-place settings, secrets) and one class that reads, checks and wraps them all: a missing key in real mode or a typo in LLM_MODE stops with a message that names the setting, and a SecretStr prints as stars. A small finder checks the files Git tracks, and a real leak in a throwaway repository shows that a removed password is still in the history.
goal: M13: move a secret out of the code.

items.text: Add settings.py with a SecretStr and tests, and switch deps.py and ingest.py to it
Run pytest and mypy: everything that passed before still passes
Add a setting of your own with a default, and read the error for a bad value
Print the settings and see stars, then call api_key() on purpose
Run find_secrets.py in each of your projects
In a throwaway folder commit a fake password, remove it, and find it with git log -p -S
Play the Settings Check game to the end and see your score
